literal: Modesty inside those who have not, movement, wooden puppet by string life having deceived like that.
translation: The actions of those who have no modesty in their hearts are like a wooden puppet creating the illusion of life by means of a string.
modern: மனதில் நாணம் இல்லாதவர்களின் செயல்பாடுகள், கயிற்றினால் இயக்கப்படும் மரப்பாவை உயிருள்ளது போல மயக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்துவதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet uses a brilliant pun on the word 'நாண்', which means both 'modesty' and 'string'. It compares people who lack inner modesty to wooden puppets. Just as a puppet seems alive only because it is pulled by a string, shameless people merely go through the motions of life without true human dignity. Their outward actions are just an illusion of living.
